notes.title: The God's Chain v1.2 (Update)
notes.notes:
The God's Chain has been updated

New Level added in War Mode in Multiplayer
Fixed minor Bugs 
Increased Visual Effects
Optimized the game 
Enhanced the Multiplayer experience 
Fixed lag compensation, hitbox and hit detection issues 
Implemented the newest version of SteamAPI 
Added more Profile Backgrounds that you can earn for your inventory

Suggestion - You must try War,Death Match and Team Death Match in Multiplayer mode.A lot of work has been done on it.

notes.title: The God's Chain v1.1 (Update)
notes.notes:
The God's Chain has been updated 

 Trading Cards,Badges,Backgrounds and Emoticons are now active.Play to win them.
 Removed the problem of Scene Freeze
 Fixed minor Bugs
 Optimized the game
 Enhanced the Multiplayer experience
 Fixed lag compensation, hitbox and hit detection issues
 Removed certain SteamAPI calls at game startup 
 Implemented the newest version of SteamAPI

Suggestion - You must try Death Match,Team Death Match in Multiplayer mode.A lot of work has been done on it.

Another update is coming soon
